text:
{ "entries": [
  {
    "name_han": "泄天机",
    "logic_thesis": "The text proves that destiny patterns are not sealed mysteries but causally readable once the hidden coupling of Heaven–Earth–Man is made explicit; secrecy itself is a pedagogical filter, not an ontological barrier. By “leaking” the mechanism, it demonstrates that fate can be reverse-engineered from stems, branches, and qi dynamics rather than accepted as opaque decree. The core argument is therefore epistemic: true mastery requires disclosing the algorithm of time, not accumulating more omens.",
    "logic_chain": "Premise: cosmic order operates by fixed but non-obvious rules of qi exchange → Inference: if those rules can be named, prediction becomes deduction not divination theater → Inference: traditional “heavenly secrets” were withheld to prevent misuse, not because they were unknowable → Inference: once the coupling of sexagenary cycle, five phases, and human agency is stated, luck becomes a controllable variable within bounds → Conclusion: the practitioner’s duty is to internalize the disclosed mechanism and act within its constraints rather than petition fate blindly.",
    "logic_practice": "1) Map a chart’s day master as the “man” pole and read wealth/officer/resource as explicit qi-transfer channels, not mere labels. 2) When a luck pillar “opens” a secret, treat it as activation of a named mechanism (e.g., resource feeding day master) and plan career/health timing accordingly. 3) Use the text’s anti-mystification stance: for every “bad” star, state the phase-cycle reason before any remedial ritual. 4) In cultivation, align breath/meditation schedule with the same stem-branch clocks the text treats as leakable algorithm. 5) Teach clients the causal chain so agency replaces fatalism.",
    "logic_compare": "Unlike pure verse manuals that wrap method in allegory, 《泄天机》 argues by deliberate disclosure—its uniqueness is the claim that silence was strategy, not sacred necessity. Compared with 《三命通会》-style encyclopedias, it prioritizes mechanism over catalog; compared with Neidan secrecy schools, it flips the ethic toward open logic so BaZi and cultivation share one causal grammar."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "乐育堂语录",
    "logic_thesis": "Huang Yuanji’s recorded talks prove that inner alchemy succeeds only when moral rectitude and qi method co-cause each other; technique without virtue dissipates, virtue without method stalls. The argument is that “joy of nurturing” is not sentiment but a stable psycho-physiological state produced when mind (xing) governs vital force (ming) without force. Thus cultivation is pedagogical dialogue: correct hearing realigns the practitioner’s causal model of body and destiny.",
    "logic_chain": "Premise: human nature and life-force are two aspects of one continuum → Inference: forcing qi without quieting intention creates false fire and illness → Inference: ethical restraint reduces mental noise that scatters jing → Inference: when mind is settled, natural reversion of qi follows without mechanical strain → Inference: oral instruction corrects wrong maps faster than silent reading → Conclusion: lasting transformation is the joint product of virtue, correct theory, and gentle method under living guidance.",
    "logic_practice": "1) Before adjusting a BaZi “weak day master,” first check lifestyle vices that leak jing—sleep, sex, anger—as primary causal leaks. 2) Prefer soft tonifying strategies (resource, peer support) over aggressive officer-killing remedies when the chart shows mental agitation. 3) Schedule meditation at hours when the chart’s resource or seal is strong. 4) Use teacher/mentor feedback loops the way the yu lu format does: revise method after each week’s somatic signs. 5) Treat “joy” as a metric—if practice breeds anxiety, the causal chain is inverted; stop and re-center xing.",
    "logic_compare": "Unlike scripture-only Neidan (e.g. dense 《参同契》 commentary), this is dialogic and clinical, proving claims by student symptoms. It differs from pure BaZi fatalism by insisting moral-psychological causes sit upstream of luck pillars, and from harsh dual-cultivation schools by rejecting forced fire in favor of joyful nurture."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "道门语要",
    "logic_thesis": "The work proves that Daoist orthopraxy is a compact set of causal priorities—quiet the heart, conserve jing, circulate qi, return to emptiness—rather than a heap of rites. Its “essentials in speech” form argues that verbal compression forces logical hierarchy: what can be said in few words is what actually moves the system. Therefore, extraneous techniques are noise that breaks the chain from intent to result.",
    "logic_chain": "Premise: the Dao operates simply; complexity is human accretion → Inference: essentials can be ranked by causal power (mind → jing → qi → spirit) → Inference: speech that isolates those ranks is training for discrimination → Inference: practitioners fail by adding steps that fight earlier premises → Conclusion: mastery is subtraction until only the necessary causal sequence remains.",
    "logic_practice": "1) Distill any BaZi reading to three causal drivers (day master strength, useful god, timing) and discard ornamental star lore. 2) In daily practice, keep a four-link stack: sit, gather, turn, rest—never more than one new technique per month. 3) When chart and body conflict, trust the simpler signal (breath/pulse) as the text trusts “essentials.” 4) Write one-sentence diagnoses for clients to test whether the logic still holds without jargon. 5) Audit temples/methods: if a ritual does not map onto jing-qi-shen causality, demote it.",
    "logic_compare": "Unlike encyclopedic 《道藏》 compilations, 《道门语要》 proves by austerity of form. It is closer to Chan “direct pointing” than to elaborate thunder rites, and unlike story-heavy immortal hagiography it refuses narrative distraction so the causal spine stays visible."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "黄庭经讲义",
    "logic_thesis": "The lecture proves that the body is a multi-court administrative cosmos: each visceral “palace” has officers, fluids, and light that must be governed, not merely “balanced” as abstract five-phase tokens. Visualization and breath work are therefore political acts inside the organism—appointing attention as ruler so chaos in the yellow court ceases. The argument reframes health and longevity as correct internal governance rather than external elixir hunting.",
    "logic_chain": "Premise: 《黄庭》 maps organs as inhabited domains with hierarchical spirits → Inference: disease is misrule (attention and qi absent from their posts) → Inference: recitation/visualization reinstalls conscious sovereignty in the middle court → Inference: when middle is orderly, upper and lower courts synchronize → Conclusion: longevity is administrative coherence of body-minds, readable also in BaZi as “officials” managing resources inside the person.",
    "logic_practice": "1) Pair each BaZi organ correspondence (e.g. wood-liver, fire-heart) with a concrete “court” practice: gaze soft, breath to that region, brief mental inventory. 2) For officer-star heavy charts, channel the “governance” talent into self-regulation drills rather than only external status chasing. 3) Use yellow-court centering when luck pillars agitate the middle (digestive/emotional stress years). 4) Recite or silently review body maps before sleep to reinstall attention hierarchy. 5) Diagnose chronic issues as vacant posts: which phase has no “officer” on duty in both chart and felt body?",
    "logic_compare": "Unlike purely cosmological BaZi manuals, the lecture insists on imaginal anatomy as operational software. It differs from dry medical 《黄帝内经》 by using poetic spirit-bureaucracy; it differs from purely formless Chan sitting by requiring structured inner topography."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "灵源大道歌白话注解",
    "logic_thesis": "Cao Wenyi’s song, opened in plain language, proves that the “spiritual source” is already present as quiet awareness and that elaborate laboratory alchemy is a metaphor for protecting that source from leakage. The annotation’s argument is democratizing: if vernacular can carry the full logic, enlightenment is not class-bound. Causally, stillness concentrates the source; speech and desire disperse it.",
    "logic_chain": "Premise: the great Dao is a living spring within, not a remote god → Inference: poetry encodes conservation laws for that spring → Inference: vernacular commentary removes priestly monopoly on decoding → Inference: daily speech/emotion habits either silt or clear the spring → Conclusion: practice is continuous non-leakage of the source through ordinary life, not only ritual hours.",
    "logic_practice": "1) For BaZi charts with strong output/hurting officer, train verbal restraint as qi conservation—speech is output of the spring. 2) Use the song’s stillness cues at the hour of the day master’s season to “return to source.” 3) Replace occult jargon in teaching with plain causal sentences modeled on the baihua notes. 4) Track one week of emotional leaks (anger, flirtation, overwork) as measurable jing loss. 5) Women and men both apply the same source logic; gender enters only as physiological pacing, not as lesser access to Dao.",
    "logic_compare": "Unlike male-coded dual-cultivation texts, this lineage centers a female immortal’s voice and proves universality via plain speech. Compared with opaque 《悟真篇》 symbolism, the vernacular notes argue that clarity itself is a spiritual technology; compared with temple liturgy, it relocates authority to the inner spring."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "口诀钩玄录",
    "logic_thesis": "The text proves that oral formulas (koujue) are compressed causal operators: each phrase is a trigger that reconfigures attention and qi only if the practitioner already holds the right premises. “Hooking the profound” means extracting the invariant logic from variant wordings so one is not enslaved to a single master’s phrasing. Thus lineage secrets are portable algorithms, not magic strings.",
    "logic_chain": "Premise: true methods were transmitted in short oral keys → Inference: keys fail when premises (timing, virtue, body state) are missing → Inference: comparing multiple formulas reveals the shared deep structure → Inference: recording the deep structure prevents both loss and blind chanting → Conclusion: the practitioner must reverse-engineer koujue into explicit if-then causal rules before applying them.",
    "logic_practice": "1) Convert every BaZi slogan (“kill the official to seek wealth”) into a conditional: IF day master strong AND official excessive THEN… 2) Keep a personal hook-xuan notebook: formula → premises → somatic test → result. 3) Never apply a fire-timing koujue in a chart year that lacks fire support. 4) Cross-check three lineages’ phrases for the same stage (e.g. zhuji) and keep only the shared causal core. 5) Teach students the premises first; give the phrase last so it cannot be fetishized.",
    "logic_compare": "Unlike narrative 《钟吕传道集》, this work is meta-methodological: it argues about how secrets work. It differs from printed public scriptures by treating orality as compression technology, and from purely academic philology by requiring embodied verification of each hook."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "卫生生理学明指",
    "logic_thesis": "The treatise proves that longevity arts are applied physiology: hygiene, breath, diet, and sexual restraint are measurable causes of qi economy, not mere moral taboos. By “clearly pointing,” it argues that mystical results supervene on ordinary biological regularities correctly ordered. Fate (ming) is partly renegotiated by daily physiological policy.",
    "logic_chain": "Premise: life depends on finite jing and rhythmic qi → Inference: disease is economic bankruptcy of those resources → Inference: clear protocols (sleep, food, breath, moderation) restore surplus → Inference: surplus enables higher practices (meditation, inner vision) → Conclusion: spiritual attainment without sanitary physiology is causally inverted and unstable.",
    "logic_practice": "1) In BaZi health years (clash of resource or edge of day master), prioritize sleep and diet over new esoteric techniques. 2) Map five-phase food and activity to chart deficiencies (e.g. weak earth → regular meals, less worry rumination). 3) Treat sexual output as a budget line item when output stars are already strong. 4) Use pulse/breath rate as feedback that luck-pillar stress is physiological, not only symbolic. 5) Build a daily “ming maintenance” checklist before any fortune ritual.",
    "logic_compare": "Unlike purely alchemical metaphor texts, this insists on hygienic materialism as the base layer. It differs from modern biomedicine by retaining qi accounting, and from moralistic precept lists by grounding each rule in physiological causality rather than sin."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "教外别传",
    "logic_thesis": "The phrase-as-program proves that ultimate realization is transmitted outside institutional teaching forms—yet not without causality: mind-to-mind seal works only when both sides share prepared silence. The argument is that scriptures and rituals are scaffolding; the load-bearing beam is direct recognition. Applied to BaZi/cultivation, charts and methods are fingers; the moon is unconstructed awareness already free of stem-branch bondage.",
    "logic_chain": "Premise: institutional doctrine can point but not deliver the thing itself → Inference: a separate transmission exists as shared non-conceptual recognition → Inference: words after that recognition are skillful means, not the substance → Inference: clinging to school forms recreates the prison the form was meant to exit → Conclusion: practice culminates in dropping even the map of fate while still skillfully using maps for others.",
    "logic_practice": "1) After full BaZi analysis, add a final step: rest as the one who is not any pillar. 2) Use chart work as upaya—help clients act—without reifying stars as soul essence. 3) Alternate technical study days with formless sitting so “outside the teaching” stays alive. 4) When lineages conflict, return to direct verification in breath and clarity rather than citation wars. 5) Mark progress by decreased fear of “bad luck,” not by more complex readings.",
    "logic_compare": "Though often Chan-coded, the logic challenges Daoist scholasticism equally: it differs from 《碧苑坛经》’s structured Quanzhen curriculum by denying final authority to curriculum. Unlike 《泄天机》’s disclosure of mechanisms, it claims the last step is not more mechanism but freedom from mechanism-identification."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "天乐集",
    "logic_thesis": "The collection proves that celestial joy is a criterion of correct alignment: when human timing matches heavenly pattern, affect itself becomes evidence of truth. Joy is not entertainment but the phenomenal mark that resistance between will and Dao has dropped. Thus aesthetic and hymn-like expression are epistemic, not decorative.",
    "logic_chain": "Premise: heaven’s order has a felt signature in the cultivated body-mind → Inference: forced practice produces strain; resonant practice produces ease/joy → Inference: anthologizing songs and insights preserves those signatures across persons → Inference: comparing joyless vs joyful methods selects for causal fitness → Conclusion: “heavenly joy” is both goal-state and feedback signal for path correction.",
    "logic_practice": "1) Rate each BaZi remedy by whether the client’s life energy lightens within one luck-month cycle. 2) Prefer career and relationship moves that increase quiet joy over prestige that increases tightness. 3) Use seasonal festivals/hymns as collective entrainment to heavenly rhythm. 4) Abandon techniques that chronically produce grim effort without periodic lightness. 5) In chart counseling, listen for spontaneous relief language as confirmation of a correct useful god.",
    "logic_compare": "Unlike austere ascetic manuals that distrust pleasure, 《天乐集》 elevates joy as valid data. It differs from purely technical 《上品丹法节次》 by treating affect as instrument panel, and from folk festival Daoism by tying joy to precise alignment rather than carnival release alone."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "太上十三经注解",
    "logic_thesis": "The annotated set proves that the Daoist canon’s core is a networked logic of thirteen foundational scriptures: ethics (e.g. 《清静经》), ontology, and practice texts mutually entail one another. Annotation demonstrates that no single jing is self-sufficient; contradictions resolve when each is scoped to its causal layer (precept, cosmology, method). Orthodoxy is coherence across the set, not loyalty to one slogan.",
    "logic_chain": "Premise: multiple short classics were preserved as a minimal curriculum → Inference: each classic answers a different question (what is Dao, how to still, how to act) → Inference: annotation cross-links terms so students see one system → Inference: misreading arises from isolating one jing’s rhetoric → Conclusion: correct practice is multi-scriptural: virtue, stillness, and technique co-constrained.",
    "logic_practice": "1) Pair BaZi ethics (do not harm with predictions) with 《太上感应篇》-type causality in the set. 2) When a chart shows chaos, apply清静 logic before complex date selection. 3) Build a personal syllabus cycling the thirteen so theory layers stay balanced. 4) Resolve conflicting advice by asking which “layer” the text addresses. 5) Annotate your own case studies the way the book annotates jing—term, layer, application.",
    "logic_compare": "Unlike single-text fetishism (one 《阴符》 for all problems), this corpus argument is modular. It differs from esoteric Neidan exclusivism by keeping precept classics in the same logical lattice as practice texts, and from academic sinology by still aiming at transformation rather than only philology."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "碧苑坛经",
    "logic_thesis": "Liu Yiming’s platform scripture proves that Quanzhen cultivation is a graded causal curriculum: clarifying the mind, building the foundation, and dual cultivation of nature and life must occur in order. The “altar” setting argues that public, reasoned exposition can replace secretive obscurantism without losing depth. Destiny work and Neidan share one principle: reverse the worldly flow with clear stages.",
    "logic_chain": "Premise: confused mind cannot host advanced qi work → Inference: doctrinal clarity and precepts are stage-one causes → Inference: foundation (zhuji) creates surplus for later firing process → Inference: xing and ming must be paired or one side collapses → Conclusion: skipping stages produces false fulfillment; true immortality logic is sequential and teachable in open forum.",
    "logic_practice": "1) Sequence BaZi counseling: mindset/virtue, then structure (useful god), then timing tactics—never luck pillars first. 2) For weak charts, spend years on foundation (health, skill, resource stars) before risky output years. 3) Use Liu-style plain metaphors to explain chart patterns so clients own the causal model. 4) Alternate sitting (xing) with life-discipline and breath (ming) weekly. 5) Treat “altar” teaching as peer accountability: review stage criteria monthly.",
    "logic_compare": "Compared with 《教外别传》’s leap beyond teaching, 《碧苑坛经》 insists stages are non-optional causes. It differs from 《乐育堂语录》 mainly in more systematic Quanzhen architecture, and from cryptic Song Neidan poetry by choosing platform clarity as its rhetorical proof."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "上品丹法节次",
    "logic_thesis": "The text proves that superior elixir method is defined by ordered nodes (jieci): each step is a necessary cause of the next, so rearranging steps is not creativity but causal breakage. “Superior” means economy and correctness of sequence, not social rank of the practitioner. Time-of-practice and body signs are pass/fail gates between nodes.",
    "logic_chain": "Premise: alchemical transformation is multi-phase → Inference: each phase consumes products of the prior phase → Inference: written step-lists encode those dependencies → Inference: somatic markers verify completion before advancement → Conclusion: high-grade method is disciplined progression through verified nodes, not simultaneous pursuit of all fires.",
    "logic_practice": "1) Mirror jieci in BaZi decade planning: foundation decade → expansion → harvest → protect, matched to luck pillars. 2) Define exit criteria for each cultivation step (sleep quality, emotional latency, breath length). 3) Forbid stacking new techniques until current node’s criteria pass. 4) Align major “firing” efforts with chart years that supply the needed phase. 5) Document step logs like lab notes—date, method, signs—to prevent self-deception.",
    "logic_compare": "Unlike loose anthology advice, this text’s uniqueness is procedural necessity. It differs from 《天乐集》’s affective criterion by privileging sequential gates, and from women’s dual-path manuals by focusing on graded firing process rather than gender-specific physiology—though the sequencing logic can transfer."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "吕祖师三尼医世功诀",
    "logic_thesis": "Attributed to Lü, the formula proves that individual cultivation, sage wisdom, and world-healing are one causal continuum: personal qi order radiates as social order when intention is correctly scaled. “Three Ni” (Confucian–Buddhist–Daoist sages) argument is synthetic: medical, ethical, and empty-nature insights must co-operate to “heal the age.” Private stillness without world-responsibility is incomplete causality.",
    "logic_chain": "Premise: the same human nature is addressed by three teaching styles → Inference: integrating their strengths yields a complete therapeutic for civilization → Inference: personal gong is the seed; world is the field → Inference: formulas that stop at personal longevity miss the final transfer → Conclusion: true high practice measures success partly by reduced harm and increased clarity in one’s social field.",
    "logic_practice": "1) Read BaZi not only for private luck but for role-fit that serves others (officer as public function, resource as teaching capacity). 2) Dedicate a portion of practice merit to concrete service matched to chart strengths. 3) Use Confucian timing ethics + Buddhist non-attachment + Daoist qi work in one weekly cycle. 4) When advising leaders, translate chart warnings into institutional hygiene, not only personal talismans. 5) Test practice by whether household/community conflict heat decreases.",
    "logic_compare": "Unlike purely eremitic Neidan, this text’s logic is civilizational. It differs from single-school polemics by requiring three-tradition synthesis, and from 《卫生生理学明指》 by extending “medicine” from body to world without dropping the body base."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "西王母女修正途十则",
    "logic_thesis": "The ten rules prove that women’s cultivation has a correct path (zhengtu) with gender-specific physiological premises—blood, breast, menstrual cycles—as primary causal variables, not optional footnotes to male methods. Queen Mother authority frames this as orthodox, not secondary. Skipping blood-settling stages to copy male “lead-mercury” talk causes harm; proper sequence yields the same Dao via different gates.",
    "logic_chain": "Premise: female body economies differ in periodic blood loss and generative potential → Inference: conservation and transformation of blood are early necessary causes → Inference: ten rules order those causes into a safe path → Inference: male-coded dual practices misapplied invert benefits into pathology → Conclusion: correct female practice is rule-governed physiology plus mind cultivation, legitimated as mainstream Dao.",
    "logic_practice": "1) In BaZi for women, weight month/day blood-related health pillars and resource stars more carefully around reproductive years. 2) Align intensive meditation away from heavy menstrual depletion unless under proper guidance. 3) Use the ten rules as a checklist before recommending any “dual cultivation” trend. 4) Build foundation via sleep, blood nourishment (earth/resource logic), and emotional non-leakage. 5) Treat Queen Mother framing as confidence training against internalized “women can’t complete the elixir” myths.",
    "logic_compare": "Unlike male default manuals that only add a chapter on women, this text recenters female physiology as the main causal track. It differs from 《女金丹》 by being more rule-list orthoprax, and from formless 《教外别传》 by insisting biological gates matter until emptied at high stage."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "壶天性果女丹十则",
    "logic_thesis": "The ten principles prove that female inner alchemy aims at “nature’s fruit” (xingguo) grown inside the gourd-heaven of the body: result is judged by matured xing, not by imitating male cranial phenomena alone. Causally, protected interior space (hu tian) plus correct tempering yields a stable fruit; haste yields barren flower. Gendered method serves universal nature-realization.",
    "logic_chain": "Premise: the body can become a self-contained heaven (gourd) → Inference: female practice specializes in gestating an interior fruit of nature → Inference: ten rules protect the gestational logic from leakage and wrong fire → Inference: fruit metaphors imply seasons—cannot force harvest → Conclusion: success is evidenced by stable virtue-wisdom-qi, the ripe fruit, not spectacular intermediate visions.",
    "logic_practice": "1) Use long luck-pillar seasons as “growing seasons” for character and skill fruit, not only money events. 2) Protect the “gourd” via privacy, reduced social drama, and conservation in output years. 3) Score practice by fruit metrics: patience, clarity, healthy cycles—not by energy fireworks. 4) For BaZi day masters needing resource, frame resource as soil for the fruit. 5) Apply seasonal pacing: spring gather, summer grow, autumn harvest, winter store—mapped to four pillars’ phases.",
    "logic_compare": "Closely related to other female ten-rule texts, its distinct logic is botanical-gestational rather than purely regulatory. Compared with 《西王母女修正途十则》, it emphasizes fruition imagery; compared with 《上品丹法节次》, it softens industrial step-language into organic ripening while still demanding order."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "敲蹻洞章",
    "logic_thesis": "The “knock and jab” chapters prove that body channels can be mechanically reminded—tapping, stretching, guided movement—to reopen qi routes that pure sitting leaves asleep. The argument is that formless mind work and formed somatic intervention are complementary causes; stubborn blocks need percussion, not only intention. Cave-chapters frame this as revealed technical knowledge for stubborn mortal bodies.",
    "logic_chain": "Premise: qi pathways can congest despite correct philosophy → Inference: physical percussion and posture changes supply the missing mechanical cause → Inference: sequenced knock-jab methods target regions in a logical order → Inference: once routes open, quieter methods maintain them with less force → Conclusion: integrated practice alternates active channel work with still cultivation for complete causality.",
    "logic_practice": "1) When BaZi shows severe clashes/punishments (body pain years), add gentle channel opening before long sitting. 2) Use short daily knock sequences on stagnant five-phase zones indicated by the chart. 3) Treat movement arts as legitimate ming work, not “less spiritual” than meditation. 4) Stop aggressive tapping if empty-fire symptoms arise; return to resource nourishment. 5) Pair with breath so mechanical stimulus and intention share one loop.",
    "logic_compare": "Unlike pure stillness schools, this text validates hands-on somatic causality. It differs from medical tuina manuals by embedding techniques in Daoist cosmologic chapters, and from visualization-only 《黄庭》 practice by insisting external mechanical triggers sometimes must come first."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "道源精微歌",
    "logic_thesis": "The song proves that the Dao’s source is subtle (jingwei): gross effort cannot grasp what only micro-attention and refined ethical listening detect. Poetic form trains the sensorium to notice faint causal signals—early deviation of mind, thin qi leaks—before they become destiny-scale disasters. Subtlety is therefore preventive logic, not aesthetic preciosity.",
    "logic_chain": "Premise: the source operates finely, beneath ordinary sensory thresholds → Inference: songs encode hints that require slow, repeated tasting → Inference: practitioners who only chase strong sensations miss early corrections → Inference: refining attention restores contact with the source → Conclusion: cultivation and BaZi timing both improve when one tracks subtle leading indicators, not only crises.",
    "logic_practice": "1) In chart work, watch tiny annual indicators (a single earthly branch combine) as early warnings, not wait for decade shocks. 2) End each sit with a one-minute scan for faint emotional residue. 3) Recite or hum the song slowly to entrain fine attention. 4) Reduce stimulant lifestyle that numbs subtlety (over-caffeine, doomscrolling). 5) Journal micro-synchronicities between luck days and body-mood for calibration.",
    "logic_compare": "Unlike 《泄天机》’s bold disclosure of mechanisms, this text trains sensitivity to weak signals. It differs from procedural 《上品丹法节次》 by poetic subtlety rather than node lists, and from hygienic 《卫生生理学明指》 by aiming at fine mind-qi texture beyond basic health rules."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "壺天性果女丹十則",
    "logic_thesis": "This orthographic twin of the gourd-heaven female elixir rules re-proves the same causal thesis under classical script: interiorized heaven, gestational pacing, and nature-fruit as success criteria. The reappearance of the title in traditional characters underscores transmission stability—the logic is invariant under script reform. Women’s dan path remains: protect the vessel, follow ten constraints, ripen xing.",
    "logic_chain": "Premise: the same ten-rule system circulated in classical graph form → Inference: textual stability implies doctrinal stability of female gestational logic → Inference: practitioners should not invent contradictory “secret” steps that violate vessel-protection → Inference: fruit of nature remains the telos across editions → Conclusion: authentic practice is fidelity to the tenfold causal order, not novelty of wording.",
    "logic_practice": "1) When consulting multiple editions, unify on shared rules; discard edition-only flourishes that lack causal role. 2) Same BaZi applications as the simplified sister entry: soil (resource), seasons, fruit metrics. 3) Use classical-script study to slow reading and increase reverence without adding superstition. 4) Cross-check any modern “female dan” course against the ten rules’ protective logic. 5) Teach that script difference is not method difference—avoid false lineage splits.",
    "logic_compare": "Versus its simplified counterpart, the difference is transmission medium, not thesis—this entry highlights textual-critical logic. Versus 《女金丹》, it is more compact and fruit-centered; versus male jieci texts, it keeps organic gestational causality as the differentiator."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "女金丹",
    "logic_thesis": "The work proves that “female golden elixir” is a complete, self-sufficient system: women’s generative power is not a handicap but an alternate furnace with its own pharmacopoeia of stages, warnings, and attainments. The argument dismantles the premise that women must become quasi-male to finish the path. Causally, transforming xue/qi along female lines yields the same golden solidity of spirit.",
    "logic_chain": "Premise: golden elixir means irreversible spiritual-physiological stability → Inference: multiple bodily routes can produce that stability → Inference: female route centers periodic blood and pure yin refinement differently ordered → Inference: specialized texts are required because copying male firing maps fails → Conclusion: female jindan is orthodox completion via gender-true causes, not a consolation prize.",
    "logic_practice": "1) Build BaZi health plans that treat reproductive and blood dynamics as first-class variables across luck cycles. 2) Sequence practice: regulate menses/emotions → gather → refine → spiritualize, matching text stages. 3) Reject any teacher who denies full completion possible for women. 4) Use metal/gold imagery as criterion of non-retrogression (stable boundaries, clear will). 5) Coordinate medical gynecological care with cultivation pacing rather than ignoring either.",
    "logic_compare": "Broader and more “system manual” than the short ten-rule tracts, 《女金丹》 aims at full elixir framing. It differs from 《西王母女修正途十则》 by denser method narrative, and from 《吕祖师三尼医世功诀》 by focusing on gendered body causality rather than world-healing synthesis."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "坤寧經",
    "logic_thesis": "The scripture proves that kun (pure yin, earthly, feminine, household, receptive power) attains peace (ning) not by imitating qian’s assertiveness but by perfecting receptive order—stability, containment, and generative quiet. thought: The user wants me to extract logical reasoning from classical BaZi/Daoist texts. They want a structured JSON output with specific fields for 20 texts. Let me research these texts to ensure accuracy - ...

entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that destiny patterns are not sealed mysteries but causally readable once the hidden coupling of Heaven–Earth–Man is made explicit; secrecy itself is a pedagogical filter, not an ontological barrier. By “leaking” the mechanism, it demonstrates that fate can be reverse-engineered from stems, branches, and qi dynamics rather than accepted as opaque decree. The core argument is therefore epistemic: true mastery requires disclosing the algorithm of time, not accumulating more omens.
entries.logic_chain: Premise: cosmic order operates by fixed but non-obvious rules of qi exchange → Inference: if those rules can be named, prediction becomes deduction not divination theater → Inference: traditional “heavenly secrets” were withheld to prevent misuse, not because they were unknowable → Inference: once the coupling of sexagenary cycle, five phases, and human agency is stated, luck becomes a controllable variable within bounds → Conclusion: the practitioner’s duty is to internalize the disclosed mechanism and act within its constraints rather than petition fate blindly.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Map a chart’s day master as the “man” pole and read wealth/officer/resource as explicit qi-transfer channels, not mere labels. 2) When a luck pillar “opens” a secret, treat it as activation of a named mechanism (e.g., resource feeding day master) and plan career/health timing accordingly. 3) Use the text’s anti-mystification stance: for every “bad” star, state the phase-cycle reason before any remedial ritual. 4) In cultivation, align breath/meditation schedule with the same stem-branch clocks the text treats as leakable algorithm. 5) Teach clients the causal chain so agency replaces fatalism.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike pure verse manuals that wrap method in allegory, 《泄天机》 argues by deliberate disclosure—its uniqueness is the claim that silence was strategy, not sacred necessity. Compared with 《三命通会》-style encyclopedias, it prioritizes mechanism over catalog; compared with Neidan secrecy schools, it flips the ethic toward open logic so BaZi and cultivation share one causal grammar.

entries.logic_thesis: Huang Yuanji’s recorded talks prove that inner alchemy succeeds only when moral rectitude and qi method co-cause each other; technique without virtue dissipates, virtue without method stalls. The argument is that “joy of nurturing” is not sentiment but a stable psycho-physiological state produced when mind (xing) governs vital force (ming) without force. Thus cultivation is pedagogical dialogue: correct hearing realigns the practitioner’s causal model of body and destiny.
entries.logic_chain: Premise: human nature and life-force are two aspects of one continuum → Inference: forcing qi without quieting intention creates false fire and illness → Inference: ethical restraint reduces mental noise that scatters jing → Inference: when mind is settled, natural reversion of qi follows without mechanical strain → Inference: oral instruction corrects wrong maps faster than silent reading → Conclusion: lasting transformation is the joint product of virtue, correct theory, and gentle method under living guidance.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Before adjusting a BaZi “weak day master,” first check lifestyle vices that leak jing—sleep, sex, anger—as primary causal leaks. 2) Prefer soft tonifying strategies (resource, peer support) over aggressive officer-killing remedies when the chart shows mental agitation. 3) Schedule meditation at hours when the chart’s resource or seal is strong. 4) Use teacher/mentor feedback loops the way the yu lu format does: revise method after each week’s somatic signs. 5) Treat “joy” as a metric—if practice breeds anxiety, the causal chain is inverted; stop and re-center xing.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike scripture-only Neidan (e.g. dense 《参同契》 commentary), this is dialogic and clinical, proving claims by student symptoms. It differs from pure BaZi fatalism by insisting moral-psychological causes sit upstream of luck pillars, and from harsh dual-cultivation schools by rejecting forced fire in favor of joyful nurture.

entries.logic_thesis: The work proves that Daoist orthopraxy is a compact set of causal priorities—quiet the heart, conserve jing, circulate qi, return to emptiness—rather than a heap of rites. Its “essentials in speech” form argues that verbal compression forces logical hierarchy: what can be said in few words is what actually moves the system. Therefore, extraneous techniques are noise that breaks the chain from intent to result.
entries.logic_chain: Premise: the Dao operates simply; complexity is human accretion → Inference: essentials can be ranked by causal power (mind → jing → qi → spirit) → Inference: speech that isolates those ranks is training for discrimination → Inference: practitioners fail by adding steps that fight earlier premises → Conclusion: mastery is subtraction until only the necessary causal sequence remains.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Distill any BaZi reading to three causal drivers (day master strength, useful god, timing) and discard ornamental star lore. 2) In daily practice, keep a four-link stack: sit, gather, turn, rest—never more than one new technique per month. 3) When chart and body conflict, trust the simpler signal (breath/pulse) as the text trusts “essentials.” 4) Write one-sentence diagnoses for clients to test whether the logic still holds without jargon. 5) Audit temples/methods: if a ritual does not map onto jing-qi-shen causality, demote it.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike encyclopedic 《道藏》 compilations, 《道门语要》 proves by austerity of form. It is closer to Chan “direct pointing” than to elaborate thunder rites, and unlike story-heavy immortal hagiography it refuses narrative distraction so the causal spine stays visible.

entries.logic_thesis: The lecture proves that the body is a multi-court administrative cosmos: each visceral “palace” has officers, fluids, and light that must be governed, not merely “balanced” as abstract five-phase tokens. Visualization and breath work are therefore political acts inside the organism—appointing attention as ruler so chaos in the yellow court ceases. The argument reframes health and longevity as correct internal governance rather than external elixir hunting.
entries.logic_chain: Premise: 《黄庭》 maps organs as inhabited domains with hierarchical spirits → Inference: disease is misrule (attention and qi absent from their posts) → Inference: recitation/visualization reinstalls conscious sovereignty in the middle court → Inference: when middle is orderly, upper and lower courts synchronize → Conclusion: longevity is administrative coherence of body-minds, readable also in BaZi as “officials” managing resources inside the person.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Pair each BaZi organ correspondence (e.g. wood-liver, fire-heart) with a concrete “court” practice: gaze soft, breath to that region, brief mental inventory. 2) For officer-star heavy charts, channel the “governance” talent into self-regulation drills rather than only external status chasing. 3) Use yellow-court centering when luck pillars agitate the middle (digestive/emotional stress years). 4) Recite or silently review body maps before sleep to reinstall attention hierarchy. 5) Diagnose chronic issues as vacant posts: which phase has no “officer” on duty in both chart and felt body?
entries.logic_compare: Unlike purely cosmological BaZi manuals, the lecture insists on imaginal anatomy as operational software. It differs from dry medical 《黄帝内经》 by using poetic spirit-bureaucracy; it differs from purely formless Chan sitting by requiring structured inner topography.

entries.logic_thesis: Cao Wenyi’s song, opened in plain language, proves that the “spiritual source” is already present as quiet awareness and that elaborate laboratory alchemy is a metaphor for protecting that source from leakage. The annotation’s argument is democratizing: if vernacular can carry the full logic, enlightenment is not class-bound. Causally, stillness concentrates the source; speech and desire disperse it.
entries.logic_chain: Premise: the great Dao is a living spring within, not a remote god → Inference: poetry encodes conservation laws for that spring → Inference: vernacular commentary removes priestly monopoly on decoding → Inference: daily speech/emotion habits either silt or clear the spring → Conclusion: practice is continuous non-leakage of the source through ordinary life, not only ritual hours.
entries.logic_practice: 1) For BaZi charts with strong output/hurting officer, train verbal restraint as qi conservation—speech is output of the spring. 2) Use the song’s stillness cues at the hour of the day master’s season to “return to source.” 3) Replace occult jargon in teaching with plain causal sentences modeled on the baihua notes. 4) Track one week of emotional leaks (anger, flirtation, overwork) as measurable jing loss. 5) Women and men both apply the same source logic; gender enters only as physiological pacing, not as lesser access to Dao.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike male-coded dual-cultivation texts, this lineage centers a female immortal’s voice and proves universality via plain speech. Compared with opaque 《悟真篇》 symbolism, the vernacular notes argue that clarity itself is a spiritual technology; compared with temple liturgy, it relocates authority to the inner spring.

entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that oral formulas (koujue) are compressed causal operators: each phrase is a trigger that reconfigures attention and qi only if the practitioner already holds the right premises. “Hooking the profound” means extracting the invariant logic from variant wordings so one is not enslaved to a single master’s phrasing. Thus lineage secrets are portable algorithms, not magic strings.
entries.logic_chain: Premise: true methods were transmitted in short oral keys → Inference: keys fail when premises (timing, virtue, body state) are missing → Inference: comparing multiple formulas reveals the shared deep structure → Inference: recording the deep structure prevents both loss and blind chanting → Conclusion: the practitioner must reverse-engineer koujue into explicit if-then causal rules before applying them.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Convert every BaZi slogan (“kill the official to seek wealth”) into a conditional: IF day master strong AND official excessive THEN… 2) Keep a personal hook-xuan notebook: formula → premises → somatic test → result. 3) Never apply a fire-timing koujue in a chart year that lacks fire support. 4) Cross-check three lineages’ phrases for the same stage (e.g. zhuji) and keep only the shared causal core. 5) Teach students the premises first; give the phrase last so it cannot be fetishized.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike narrative 《钟吕传道集》, this work is meta-methodological: it argues about how secrets work. It differs from printed public scriptures by treating orality as compression technology, and from purely academic philology by requiring embodied verification of each hook.

entries.logic_thesis: The treatise proves that longevity arts are applied physiology: hygiene, breath, diet, and sexual restraint are measurable causes of qi economy, not mere moral taboos. By “clearly pointing,” it argues that mystical results supervene on ordinary biological regularities correctly ordered. Fate (ming) is partly renegotiated by daily physiological policy.
entries.logic_chain: Premise: life depends on finite jing and rhythmic qi → Inference: disease is economic bankruptcy of those resources → Inference: clear protocols (sleep, food, breath, moderation) restore surplus → Inference: surplus enables higher practices (meditation, inner vision) → Conclusion: spiritual attainment without sanitary physiology is causally inverted and unstable.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi health years (clash of resource or edge of day master), prioritize sleep and diet over new esoteric techniques. 2) Map five-phase food and activity to chart deficiencies (e.g. weak earth → regular meals, less worry rumination). 3) Treat sexual output as a budget line item when output stars are already strong. 4) Use pulse/breath rate as feedback that luck-pillar stress is physiological, not only symbolic. 5) Build a daily “ming maintenance” checklist before any fortune ritual.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike purely alchemical metaphor texts, this insists on hygienic materialism as the base layer. It differs from modern biomedicine by retaining qi accounting, and from moralistic precept lists by grounding each rule in physiological causality rather than sin.

entries.logic_thesis: The phrase-as-program proves that ultimate realization is transmitted outside institutional teaching forms—yet not without causality: mind-to-mind seal works only when both sides share prepared silence. The argument is that scriptures and rituals are scaffolding; the load-bearing beam is direct recognition. Applied to BaZi/cultivation, charts and methods are fingers; the moon is unconstructed awareness already free of stem-branch bondage.
entries.logic_chain: Premise: institutional doctrine can point but not deliver the thing itself → Inference: a separate transmission exists as shared non-conceptual recognition → Inference: words after that recognition are skillful means, not the substance → Inference: clinging to school forms recreates the prison the form was meant to exit → Conclusion: practice culminates in dropping even the map of fate while still skillfully using maps for others.
entries.logic_practice: 1) After full BaZi analysis, add a final step: rest as the one who is not any pillar. 2) Use chart work as upaya—help clients act—without reifying stars as soul essence. 3) Alternate technical study days with formless sitting so “outside the teaching” stays alive. 4) When lineages conflict, return to direct verification in breath and clarity rather than citation wars. 5) Mark progress by decreased fear of “bad luck,” not by more complex readings.
entries.logic_compare: Though often Chan-coded, the logic challenges Daoist scholasticism equally: it differs from 《碧苑坛经》’s structured Quanzhen curriculum by denying final authority to curriculum. Unlike 《泄天机》’s disclosure of mechanisms, it claims the last step is not more mechanism but freedom from mechanism-identification.

entries.logic_thesis: The collection proves that celestial joy is a criterion of correct alignment: when human timing matches heavenly pattern, affect itself becomes evidence of truth. Joy is not entertainment but the phenomenal mark that resistance between will and Dao has dropped. Thus aesthetic and hymn-like expression are epistemic, not decorative.
entries.logic_chain: Premise: heaven’s order has a felt signature in the cultivated body-mind → Inference: forced practice produces strain; resonant practice produces ease/joy → Inference: anthologizing songs and insights preserves those signatures across persons → Inference: comparing joyless vs joyful methods selects for causal fitness → Conclusion: “heavenly joy” is both goal-state and feedback signal for path correction.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Rate each BaZi remedy by whether the client’s life energy lightens within one luck-month cycle. 2) Prefer career and relationship moves that increase quiet joy over prestige that increases tightness. 3) Use seasonal festivals/hymns as collective entrainment to heavenly rhythm. 4) Abandon techniques that chronically produce grim effort without periodic lightness. 5) In chart counseling, listen for spontaneous relief language as confirmation of a correct useful god.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike austere ascetic manuals that distrust pleasure, 《天乐集》 elevates joy as valid data. It differs from purely technical 《上品丹法节次》 by treating affect as instrument panel, and from folk festival Daoism by tying joy to precise alignment rather than carnival release alone.

entries.logic_thesis: The annotated set proves that the Daoist canon’s core is a networked logic of thirteen foundational scriptures: ethics (e.g. 《清静经》), ontology, and practice texts mutually entail one another. Annotation demonstrates that no single jing is self-sufficient; contradictions resolve when each is scoped to its causal layer (precept, cosmology, method). Orthodoxy is coherence across the set, not loyalty to one slogan.
entries.logic_chain: Premise: multiple short classics were preserved as a minimal curriculum → Inference: each classic answers a different question (what is Dao, how to still, how to act) → Inference: annotation cross-links terms so students see one system → Inference: misreading arises from isolating one jing’s rhetoric → Conclusion: correct practice is multi-scriptural: virtue, stillness, and technique co-constrained.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Pair BaZi ethics (do not harm with predictions) with 《太上感应篇》-type causality in the set. 2) When a chart shows chaos, apply清静 logic before complex date selection. 3) Build a personal syllabus cycling the thirteen so theory layers stay balanced. 4) Resolve conflicting advice by asking which “layer” the text addresses. 5) Annotate your own case studies the way the book annotates jing—term, layer, application.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike single-text fetishism (one 《阴符》 for all problems), this corpus argument is modular. It differs from esoteric Neidan exclusivism by keeping precept classics in the same logical lattice as practice texts, and from academic sinology by still aiming at transformation rather than only philology.

entries.logic_thesis: Liu Yiming’s platform scripture proves that Quanzhen cultivation is a graded causal curriculum: clarifying the mind, building the foundation, and dual cultivation of nature and life must occur in order. The “altar” setting argues that public, reasoned exposition can replace secretive obscurantism without losing depth. Destiny work and Neidan share one principle: reverse the worldly flow with clear stages.
entries.logic_chain: Premise: confused mind cannot host advanced qi work → Inference: doctrinal clarity and precepts are stage-one causes → Inference: foundation (zhuji) creates surplus for later firing process → Inference: xing and ming must be paired or one side collapses → Conclusion: skipping stages produces false fulfillment; true immortality logic is sequential and teachable in open forum.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Sequence BaZi counseling: mindset/virtue, then structure (useful god), then timing tactics—never luck pillars first. 2) For weak charts, spend years on foundation (health, skill, resource stars) before risky output years. 3) Use Liu-style plain metaphors to explain chart patterns so clients own the causal model. 4) Alternate sitting (xing) with life-discipline and breath (ming) weekly. 5) Treat “altar” teaching as peer accountability: review stage criteria monthly.
entries.logic_compare: Compared with 《教外别传》’s leap beyond teaching, 《碧苑坛经》 insists stages are non-optional causes. It differs from 《乐育堂语录》 mainly in more systematic Quanzhen architecture, and from cryptic Song Neidan poetry by choosing platform clarity as its rhetorical proof.

entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that superior elixir method is defined by ordered nodes (jieci): each step is a necessary cause of the next, so rearranging steps is not creativity but causal breakage. “Superior” means economy and correctness of sequence, not social rank of the practitioner. Time-of-practice and body signs are pass/fail gates between nodes.
entries.logic_chain: Premise: alchemical transformation is multi-phase → Inference: each phase consumes products of the prior phase → Inference: written step-lists encode those dependencies → Inference: somatic markers verify completion before advancement → Conclusion: high-grade method is disciplined progression through verified nodes, not simultaneous pursuit of all fires.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Mirror jieci in BaZi decade planning: foundation decade → expansion → harvest → protect, matched to luck pillars. 2) Define exit criteria for each cultivation step (sleep quality, emotional latency, breath length). 3) Forbid stacking new techniques until current node’s criteria pass. 4) Align major “firing” efforts with chart years that supply the needed phase. 5) Document step logs like lab notes—date, method, signs—to prevent self-deception.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike loose anthology advice, this text’s uniqueness is procedural necessity. It differs from 《天乐集》’s affective criterion by privileging sequential gates, and from women’s dual-path manuals by focusing on graded firing process rather than gender-specific physiology—though the sequencing logic can transfer.

entries.logic_thesis: Attributed to Lü, the formula proves that individual cultivation, sage wisdom, and world-healing are one causal continuum: personal qi order radiates as social order when intention is correctly scaled. “Three Ni” (Confucian–Buddhist–Daoist sages) argument is synthetic: medical, ethical, and empty-nature insights must co-operate to “heal the age.” Private stillness without world-responsibility is incomplete causality.
entries.logic_chain: Premise: the same human nature is addressed by three teaching styles → Inference: integrating their strengths yields a complete therapeutic for civilization → Inference: personal gong is the seed; world is the field → Inference: formulas that stop at personal longevity miss the final transfer → Conclusion: true high practice measures success partly by reduced harm and increased clarity in one’s social field.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Read BaZi not only for private luck but for role-fit that serves others (officer as public function, resource as teaching capacity). 2) Dedicate a portion of practice merit to concrete service matched to chart strengths. 3) Use Confucian timing ethics + Buddhist non-attachment + Daoist qi work in one weekly cycle. 4) When advising leaders, translate chart warnings into institutional hygiene, not only personal talismans. 5) Test practice by whether household/community conflict heat decreases.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike purely eremitic Neidan, this text’s logic is civilizational. It differs from single-school polemics by requiring three-tradition synthesis, and from 《卫生生理学明指》 by extending “medicine” from body to world without dropping the body base.

entries.logic_thesis: The ten rules prove that women’s cultivation has a correct path (zhengtu) with gender-specific physiological premises—blood, breast, menstrual cycles—as primary causal variables, not optional footnotes to male methods. Queen Mother authority frames this as orthodox, not secondary. Skipping blood-settling stages to copy male “lead-mercury” talk causes harm; proper sequence yields the same Dao via different gates.
entries.logic_chain: Premise: female body economies differ in periodic blood loss and generative potential → Inference: conservation and transformation of blood are early necessary causes → Inference: ten rules order those causes into a safe path → Inference: male-coded dual practices misapplied invert benefits into pathology → Conclusion: correct female practice is rule-governed physiology plus mind cultivation, legitimated as mainstream Dao.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi for women, weight month/day blood-related health pillars and resource stars more carefully around reproductive years. 2) Align intensive meditation away from heavy menstrual depletion unless under proper guidance. 3) Use the ten rules as a checklist before recommending any “dual cultivation” trend. 4) Build foundation via sleep, blood nourishment (earth/resource logic), and emotional non-leakage. 5) Treat Queen Mother framing as confidence training against internalized “women can’t complete the elixir” myths.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike male default manuals that only add a chapter on women, this text recenters female physiology as the main causal track. It differs from 《女金丹》 by being more rule-list orthoprax, and from formless 《教外别传》 by insisting biological gates matter until emptied at high stage.

entries.logic_thesis: The ten principles prove that female inner alchemy aims at “nature’s fruit” (xingguo) grown inside the gourd-heaven of the body: result is judged by matured xing, not by imitating male cranial phenomena alone. Causally, protected interior space (hu tian) plus correct tempering yields a stable fruit; haste yields barren flower. Gendered method serves universal nature-realization.
entries.logic_chain: Premise: the body can become a self-contained heaven (gourd) → Inference: female practice specializes in gestating an interior fruit of nature → Inference: ten rules protect the gestational logic from leakage and wrong fire → Inference: fruit metaphors imply seasons—cannot force harvest → Conclusion: success is evidenced by stable virtue-wisdom-qi, the ripe fruit, not spectacular intermediate visions.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Use long luck-pillar seasons as “growing seasons” for character and skill fruit, not only money events. 2) Protect the “gourd” via privacy, reduced social drama, and conservation in output years. 3) Score practice by fruit metrics: patience, clarity, healthy cycles—not by energy fireworks. 4) For BaZi day masters needing resource, frame resource as soil for the fruit. 5) Apply seasonal pacing: spring gather, summer grow, autumn harvest, winter store—mapped to four pillars’ phases.
entries.logic_compare: Closely related to other female ten-rule texts, its distinct logic is botanical-gestational rather than purely regulatory. Compared with 《西王母女修正途十则》, it emphasizes fruition imagery; compared with 《上品丹法节次》, it softens industrial step-language into organic ripening while still demanding order.

entries.logic_thesis: The “knock and jab” chapters prove that body channels can be mechanically reminded—tapping, stretching, guided movement—to reopen qi routes that pure sitting leaves asleep. The argument is that formless mind work and formed somatic intervention are complementary causes; stubborn blocks need percussion, not only intention. Cave-chapters frame this as revealed technical knowledge for stubborn mortal bodies.
entries.logic_chain: Premise: qi pathways can congest despite correct philosophy → Inference: physical percussion and posture changes supply the missing mechanical cause → Inference: sequenced knock-jab methods target regions in a logical order → Inference: once routes open, quieter methods maintain them with less force → Conclusion: integrated practice alternates active channel work with still cultivation for complete causality.
entries.logic_practice: 1) When BaZi shows severe clashes/punishments (body pain years), add gentle channel opening before long sitting. 2) Use short daily knock sequences on stagnant five-phase zones indicated by the chart. 3) Treat movement arts as legitimate ming work, not “less spiritual” than meditation. 4) Stop aggressive tapping if empty-fire symptoms arise; return to resource nourishment. 5) Pair with breath so mechanical stimulus and intention share one loop.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike pure stillness schools, this text validates hands-on somatic causality. It differs from medical tuina manuals by embedding techniques in Daoist cosmologic chapters, and from visualization-only 《黄庭》 practice by insisting external mechanical triggers sometimes must come first.

entries.logic_thesis: The song proves that the Dao’s source is subtle (jingwei): gross effort cannot grasp what only micro-attention and refined ethical listening detect. Poetic form trains the sensorium to notice faint causal signals—early deviation of mind, thin qi leaks—before they become destiny-scale disasters. Subtlety is therefore preventive logic, not aesthetic preciosity.
entries.logic_chain: Premise: the source operates finely, beneath ordinary sensory thresholds → Inference: songs encode hints that require slow, repeated tasting → Inference: practitioners who only chase strong sensations miss early corrections → Inference: refining attention restores contact with the source → Conclusion: cultivation and BaZi timing both improve when one tracks subtle leading indicators, not only crises.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In chart work, watch tiny annual indicators (a single earthly branch combine) as early warnings, not wait for decade shocks. 2) End each sit with a one-minute scan for faint emotional residue. 3) Recite or hum the song slowly to entrain fine attention. 4) Reduce stimulant lifestyle that numbs subtlety (over-caffeine, doomscrolling). 5) Journal micro-synchronicities between luck days and body-mood for calibration.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 《泄天机》’s bold disclosure of mechanisms, this text trains sensitivity to weak signals. It differs from procedural 《上品丹法节次》 by poetic subtlety rather than node lists, and from hygienic 《卫生生理学明指》 by aiming at fine mind-qi texture beyond basic health rules.

entries.logic_thesis: This orthographic twin of the gourd-heaven female elixir rules re-proves the same causal thesis under classical script: interiorized heaven, gestational pacing, and nature-fruit as success criteria. The reappearance of the title in traditional characters underscores transmission stability—the logic is invariant under script reform. Women’s dan path remains: protect the vessel, follow ten constraints, ripen xing.
entries.logic_chain: Premise: the same ten-rule system circulated in classical graph form → Inference: textual stability implies doctrinal stability of female gestational logic → Inference: practitioners should not invent contradictory “secret” steps that violate vessel-protection → Inference: fruit of nature remains the telos across editions → Conclusion: authentic practice is fidelity to the tenfold causal order, not novelty of wording.
entries.logic_practice: 1) When consulting multiple editions, unify on shared rules; discard edition-only flourishes that lack causal role. 2) Same BaZi applications as the simplified sister entry: soil (resource), seasons, fruit metrics. 3) Use classical-script study to slow reading and increase reverence without adding superstition. 4) Cross-check any modern “female dan” course against the ten rules’ protective logic. 5) Teach that script difference is not method difference—avoid false lineage splits.
entries.logic_compare: Versus its simplified counterpart, the difference is transmission medium, not thesis—this entry highlights textual-critical logic. Versus 《女金丹》, it is more compact and fruit-centered; versus male jieci texts, it keeps organic gestational causality as the differentiator.

entries.logic_thesis: The work proves that “female golden elixir” is a complete, self-sufficient system: women’s generative power is not a handicap but an alternate furnace with its own pharmacopoeia of stages, warnings, and attainments. The argument dismantles the premise that women must become quasi-male to finish the path. Causally, transforming xue/qi along female lines yields the same golden solidity of spirit.
entries.logic_chain: Premise: golden elixir means irreversible spiritual-physiological stability → Inference: multiple bodily routes can produce that stability → Inference: female route centers periodic blood and pure yin refinement differently ordered → Inference: specialized texts are required because copying male firing maps fails → Conclusion: female jindan is orthodox completion via gender-true causes, not a consolation prize.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Build BaZi health plans that treat reproductive and blood dynamics as first-class variables across luck cycles. 2) Sequence practice: regulate menses/emotions → gather → refine → spiritualize, matching text stages. 3) Reject any teacher who denies full completion possible for women. 4) Use metal/gold imagery as criterion of non-retrogression (stable boundaries, clear will). 5) Coordinate medical gynecological care with cultivation pacing rather than ignoring either.
entries.logic_compare: Broader and more “system manual” than the short ten-rule tracts, 《女金丹》 aims at full elixir framing. It differs from 《西王母女修正途十则》 by denser method narrative, and from 《吕祖师三尼医世功诀》 by focusing on gendered body causality rather than world-healing synthesis.

entries.logic_thesis: The scripture proves that kun (pure yin, earthly, feminine, household, receptive power) attains peace (ning) not by imitating qian’s assertiveness but by perfecting receptive order—stability, containment, and generative quiet. Socially and somatically, peace is a positive causal state produced by right yin strength. The argument revalues yin as active principle of completion rather than mere passivity.
entries.logic_chain: Premise: kun in the Yijing logic completes qian by carrying and completing → Inference: female and yin-aspected practice perfects carrying, containing, and calming functions → Inference: unrest (body, family, mind) signals kun not yet ning → Inference: rites, precepts, and cultivation that strengthen right yin restore peace → Conclusion: destiny improves when yin functions are cultivated as primary powers, balancing any excess yang striving in chart or culture.
entries.logic_practice: 1) For BaZi charts overloaded with yang output/officer, prescribe kun-ning practices: sleep hygiene, boundary-setting, home qi order, receptive listening meditation. 2) Read strong earth/resource configurations as capacity for kun peace—train them, don’t only exploit them. 3) Use household and relationship harmony as valid cultivation metrics. 4) In female practice, prioritize calming and containing stages before aggressive ascent. 5) Apply seasonal late-day/evening practice to embody kun’s completing role in the daily cycle.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 《女金丹》’s full elixir engineering, 《坤寧經》 centers the value-ontology of yin peace. It differs from martial or thunder methods that glorify yang force, and from abstract emptiness teachings by tying peace to kun’s concrete roles—body, home, and completion of cycles—making it especially bridging for BaZi earth/yin counseling and women’s paths.
